message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. The in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two references to `fullname` so the code matches the schema. The only file changed is `src/api/users.js`. Nothing under `migrations/` was touched, since the DBA team owns it.

I chose to change the code rather than the migration because the migration has already been applied in production, so the column name there is fixed.
